requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 1: player initial spawn is on a grassy surface (grass or dirt block directly below), no clipping, no void spawn, within the generated biome.
must_include: player always spawns on a grassy surface within the biome
dreamscape

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 2: real-time block break and place operations execute successfully, block state updates in real-time, and hotbar inventory counts decrement/increment as blocks are placed and broken.
must_include: block placement and destruction is a hard requirement
breaks blocks and places blocks live during play
hotbar with 8 to 9 slots

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 3: walking continuously generates new terrain, distant terrain loads without pop-in, old chunks auto-unload, movement is smooth without stutter — seamless infinite world streaming with low memory footprint.
must_include: world streams seamlessly
chunks load and unload continuously
memory usage stays low

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 4: interacting with the imagination-tool UI (sliders for hue / saturation / dreaminess) morphs block textures across the entire world in real-time, with a per-session evolving default palette.
must_include: shader-based system where block textures morph in response to player input
UI 'imagination' tool
default palette that evolves as the player interacts

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 5: the in-game structure editor lets the player draw / design blocks, save under a name, survive a page refresh, and re-load + stamp the saved structure into the world; persistence is via IndexedDB.
must_include: custom structure builder: an editor
drag-and-drop placement, brush size selection, and pattern tools
structures persist locally via IndexedDB

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 6: post-processing effects (bloom, chromatic aberration) and particle systems make real-time, observable visual responses when the texture / theme changes.
must_include: Post-processing effects — bloom and chromatic aberration — react to texture changes
Particle systems produce the dream-like phenomena
floating spores, light trails, and ambient glow

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 7: first-person controller supports W/A/S/D movement, jump, and crouch (eye-level lowers when crouching), and collision detection prevents the player from clipping through walls / terrain.
must_include: first-person controller with smooth movement, jumping, and crouching
Collision detection and physics apply to both terrain and entities

requirements.verifier_assertion: iv_shipped_checklist item 8: the minimalist HUD displays health / inventory / imagination-tool status; the pause menu opens with resume + settings (graphics, controls) + 'Reset Dreamscape'; Reset Dreamscape regenerates the world and returns the player safely to a fresh grassy spawn.
must_include: HUD is minimalist
health, inventory, and the imagination-tool status
'Reset Dreamscape'
resume, settings
regenerates the world
